project.name: enterprise-carbon-site
project.purpose: Build an original enterprise website using IBM Carbon design patterns
project.branding: Replace IBM marks and proprietary content unless explicitly licensed

starter.note: Audit and upgrade dependencies before production use; this is not a copy of the current IBM homepage

stack.uiLibrary: @carbon/react and/or Carbon for IBM.com web components as compatible
stack.styling: Carbon tokens and Sass; avoid conflicting UI systems
stack.animations: CSS and Motion for React only when needed

design.strategy: Audit live reference and derive sizes from screenshot evidence; do not claim exact values without measurement

implementationPhases: 1. Clone starter and audit dependency compatibility
2. Audit reference page and capture comparable screenshots
3. Replace IBM-specific metadata, logos, legal and analytics with approved originals
4. Build responsive page sections using Carbon building blocks
6. Run Playwright tests and visual comparisons
